# Adaptive discriminator versus fixed reward: a synthetic policy comparison

Five seeds, 1000 actual policy rounds, two contexts and four actions. JS divergence: initial .180073, fixed .061357, adaptive .000866, empirical behavioral cloning .000562. Adaptive beats fixed, not BC. Sampled categorical counts fit the discriminator; exact expected policy gradient, unequal classifier refits. No native Persimmon, sequential rollout, human validation or model promotion.

[Code and evidence](https://github.com/Daisuke134/anicca-ops/tree/chatgpt/adaptive-h14-20261127/files/research-artifacts/adaptive-h14-2026-11-27)

Sources: [Persimmon](https://persimmon.humansand.ai/blog/persimmon.html), [GAIL](https://arxiv.org/abs/1606.03476).
